title: The Transfinite Hierarchy
description: Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own, with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

puzzle.goal: An n-dimensional hypercube has 2^(n−k) · (n choose k) faces of dimension k: choose which k coordinates vary and fix the others at 0 or 1. Its boundary is made of all faces of dimension below n. Write the alternating sum of face counts over the boundary, with the binomial coefficient written in factorials.
puzzle.name: Euler characteristic of the boundary of the n-cube (f-vector of the hypercube)
puzzle.ask: For k = 2 the face count simplifies to n(n−1)·2^(n−3). Find the number of square faces of the 5-dimensional hypercube (penteract).
puzzle.method: A k-face is fixed by choosing the k free coordinates (n choose k) and fixing each of the other n − k at one of two values; alternate signs by dimension.
